title: BTS Closes North American Leg With SoFi Stadium Finale
detail: September 6, 2026 — BTS played the fourth and final Los Angeles show of the ARIRANG World Tour's North American leg, closing out a 31-show run across 12 regions since April that drew an estimated 1.7 million fans with every stop sold out. The set ran the tour's standard 23-song rotation — including 'Run BTS,' 'WINGS 2,' 'Not Today,' 'Spring Day,' 'Dynamite,' 'IDOL,' 'FAKE LOVE,' 'MIC Drop,' and 'Fire' — closing out the Los Angeles stand that saw the city declare 'BTS Week' and light City Hall red in the group's honor. The tour now heads to Latin America, opening in Bogotá, Colombia on Oct 2.

media.caption: BTS wraps the ARIRANG World Tour's North American leg with a SoFi Stadium finale.

title: RM Celebrates Early Birthday Onstage as BTS Closes SoFi Stadium Run
detail: September 6, 2026 — During the fourth and final night of BTS's SoFi Stadium stand in Los Angeles, bandmates and ARMY marked RM's birthday six days early, since the group would no longer be together in Los Angeles by his actual Sept 12 birthday. Backstage during soundcheck, members and staff surprised him with a candle-lit cake; onstage, Suga draped a multicolor 'Happy Birthday' sash over RM's shoulders and topped him with a pink paper crown as the septet led the stadium in singing to him. ARMY organized a coordinated 'RM Birthday Project,' printing an estimated 26,000 signs held up during his closing ment and during 'ARMY Time.'

media.caption: RM is surprised with an early birthday celebration onstage during BTS's SoFi Stadium finale.
